name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited

facts.business: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Ltd is India's largest pure-play C&I renewable energy company, providing tailored decarbonisation solutions including on-site solar, large-scale solar, wind, hybrid projects, energy storage, and carbon solutions to corporate customers.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment, capital work in progress and capital advances
Transfer from CWIP to Property, plant and equipment

guidance_or_targets.statement: Target a minimum of 1.5 GW in new commissioned capacity in FY 2027, viewed as a floor, not a ceiling

key_risks: Execution bottlenecks such as land-acquisition risks
Revenue recognition estimation uncertainty (costs to complete)
facts.related_party_note: Loans given to joint ventures (₹480.35 Million in FY26), Investments made in joint ventures (₹63.80 Million in FY26), Withdrawal of current capital in joint venture (₹8.30 Million in FY26), Repayments of loans given to employees (₹5.14 Million in FY26), Change in Non-Controlling Interests (NCI) due to additional investments (₹3,492.86 Million in FY26), Repayments made to NCI holders (₹29.92 Million in FY26), Corporate Guarantee by Sponsor (Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Pvt Ltd) for borrowings.
